## Citation

To cite this package in publications, please use:

Betebenner DW, Van Iwaarden AR, Domingue B, Shang Y (2026). _SGP: Student Growth Percentiles & Percentile
Growth Trajectories._. R package version 2.3-2.2, <https://sgp.io>.

A BibTeX entry:

```bibtex
@Manual{,
  title = {{SGP}: Student Growth Percentiles \& Percentile Growth Trajectories.},
  author = {Damian W. Betebenner and Adam R. {Van Iwaarden} and Benjamin Domingue and Yi Shang},
  year = {2026},
  note = {R package version 2.3-2.2},
  url = {https://sgp.io},
}
```
